_about: IBM Technology video manifest for the YouTube connector.
_provenance: Video ids and titles were obtained by web search from this environment.
youtube.com is NOT reachable from the container this was built in (see
internal/ACCESS.md), so captions could not be fetched and no transcript
text is included here. Entries therefore ingest as `metadata_only`.
No entry carries a `summary` or `notes_file`, deliberately. Attributing
prose to a specific video whose captions were never read would produce a
citation that looks verbatim and is not - the exact failure the citation
contract exists to prevent. Run this manifest from an environment with
youtube.com egress and the connector hydrates real captions in place.
`verification` records how strongly the channel attribution is supported:
search_confirmed  - multiple independent results attribute it to IBM
search_listed     - a search result asserted IBM Technology, unverified
_hydrate: ooda index  (with youtube.com reachable) -> transcript_source becomes 'captions'
